name: Time Progress Bar
description: Five live progress bars showing how far the current year, month, day, hour and minute have elapsed, updating every second with a smooth width transition.
contents: Five labeled bars with percentage readouts for year, month, day, hour, minute
behavior: Recalculates elapsed percentages from the local clock every second
Bar widths animate with a CSS transition
Renders nothing until mounted on the client

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or remove tracked time units

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Always uses the visitor's local clock and updates once per second
